headline: Dangote Launches $2.5B Fuel Infrastructure Project for Southern Africa
summary: Aliko Dangote has begun building infrastructure intended to supply fuel across Southern Africa, targeting landlocked markets in the region.
why: Large-scale infrastructure and supply chain investments by major conglomerates can reshape regional trade routes and energy pricing structures.

impacts.name: Energy
impacts.why: New fuel infrastructure expansion increases supply capabilities across Southern Africa.
